en: 2 eggs
1 corn tortilla
2 tomatoes and 1 jalapeño
Quarter cup black beans
1 tsp oil, coriander, salt
Blend the tomatoes with the jalapeño and cook 8 minutes
Warm the tortilla in a dry pan
Fry the two eggs in the oil
Layer tortilla, beans, eggs, then the sauce
2 slices wholegrain bread
Half an avocado
Quarter cup cooked black beans
Juice of half a lime
Coriander, chilli flakes, salt
Mash the avocado with the lime juice and salt
Mash half the beans and leave the rest whole
Toast the bread and spread the avocado
Top with the beans, coriander and chilli flakes
Small corn tortillas, cut into triangles and baked, 60 g
Green tomatillo salsa 150 g cooked with mild green chili and garlic
Cooked, shredded chicken breast 80 g
1 lightly fried or boiled egg for garnish
Low-fat grated cheese 20 g
Chopped red onion and chopped fresh coriander for garnish
Bake the tortilla triangles in the oven at 180°C for 10-12 minutes until crisp.
Heat the green tomatillo salsa in a pan over medium heat 3-4 minutes.
Add the tortilla triangles to the salsa and toss gently to coat, add the shredded chicken and cook 2 minutes.
Distribute onto a serving plate, place the egg on top, sprinkle with cheese, red onion and coriander and serve immediately before the tortillas soften too much.

name.en: Breakfast Migas with Peppers and Onion

en: Corn tortilla, cut into small pieces, 40 g
2 eggs and 2 egg whites
Red and green bell pepper, diced, and chopped onion, 100 g total
Low-fat grated cheese 20 g
A little salt and black pepper
Light salsa 2 tbsp to serve (optional)
Brown the bell pepper and onion in a dry pan for 4-5 minutes until softened.
Whisk the eggs and egg whites with salt and black pepper.
Add the tortilla pieces to the pan, pour the egg mixture over and cook while stirring until the egg sets.
Sprinkle with cheese, let it melt for a minute, serve hot with the salsa if desired.

name.en: Baked Sweet Potato and Black Bean Breakfast Burrito

en: Sweet potato, cut into small cubes, 100 g
Canned black beans, drained, 60 g
1 egg and 1 egg white
Whole-wheat tortilla, 1 large piece (70 g)
Low-fat grated cheese 20 g
A pinch of ground cumin, salt and black pepper
Mix the sweet potato cubes with the cumin, salt and black pepper, spread on a lined tray.
Bake at 200°C for 18-20 minutes until cooked and golden.
Whisk the egg and egg white with salt and black pepper, cook in a dry pan 3-4 minutes until set.
Warm the tortilla slightly, fill with the sweet potato, beans, egg and cheese, roll tightly and serve.
Thin whole-wheat pastry sheets, 2 pieces (80 g)
Canned pumpkin puree 100 g
Ground cinnamon half a tsp and a pinch of ground cloves
Brown sugar 1 tbsp
Egg white for brushing
A pinch of vanilla extract
Mix the pumpkin puree with the cinnamon, cloves, brown sugar and vanilla until combined.
Cut each pastry sheet into a circle, place two spoonfuls of filling in the centre.
Fold the pastry in half to form a half-moon, press the edges with a fork to seal, brush with egg white.
Arrange on a lined tray, bake at 200°C for 18-20 minutes until golden, serve warm.

name.en: Baked Oaxacan-Style Egg and Bean Casserole

en: 2 eggs and 2 egg whites
Canned black beans, drained and partially mashed, 80 g
Diced tomato and chopped onion
Queso fresco or low-fat crumbled cheese 20 g
A little chopped mild chili (optional)
Chopped fresh coriander for garnish, salt and black pepper
Whisk the eggs and egg whites with salt and black pepper.
Add the partially mashed beans, tomato, onion and chili if desired, mix gently.
Pour the mixture into a small oven-safe dish, sprinkle with the cheese.
Bake at 180°C for 20-22 minutes until set and golden, garnish with coriander and serve warm.

name.en: Whole Grain Cornbread Breakfast Muffins with Jalapeño

en: Coarse cornmeal 40 g and whole-wheat flour 20 g
Low-fat milk 80 ml and 1 egg
Baking powder half a tsp
Canned sweet corn, drained, 40 g
Finely chopped jalapeño 1 tsp (optional depending on desired heat)
Low-fat grated cheese 20 g
Mix the cornmeal, flour and baking powder in a bowl.
In another bowl, whisk the milk with the egg.
Combine the two mixtures, add the corn, jalapeño and cheese, fold gently.
Distribute the batter into lined muffin tins, bake at 180°C for 20-22 minutes until golden, serve warm.

name.en: Baked Turkey Chorizo and Egg Skillet

en: Low-fat turkey chorizo, crumbled, 60 g
2 eggs and 2 egg whites
Chopped onion and diced red bell pepper
Diced tomato
A pinch of ground cumin, salt and black pepper
Chopped fresh coriander for garnish
Brown the chorizo with the onion and bell pepper in an oven-safe pan for 4-5 minutes.
Add the tomato and cumin, cook 2 minutes.
Whisk the eggs and egg whites with salt and black pepper, pour over the mixture in the pan.
Bake at 180°C for 12-15 minutes until the egg sets, garnish with coriander and serve hot.
French-style bread roll (bolillo) or whole-wheat bread, 1 large piece (80 g)
Canned beans, drained and mashed, 100 g
Low-fat grated cheese 40 g
Diced tomato and chopped red onion for the salsa
Chopped mild chili and chopped fresh coriander for the salsa
Lemon juice and a little salt for the salsa
Cut the bread in half lengthwise.
Spread the mashed beans on each half, sprinkle with the cheese.
Bake at 200°C for 10-12 minutes until the cheese melts and the bread turns golden.
Mix the tomato, onion, chili, coriander, lemon juice and salt to make the salsa, serve on top of the molletes.
150 g chicken breast, sliced
100 g cooked brown rice
1 bell pepper and 1 onion, sliced
1 tsp oil, paprika, cumin
Lime, coriander, quarter avocado
Season the chicken with paprika, cumin and salt
Sear it on high heat 6 minutes, then set aside
Sauté the pepper and onion in the same pan
Layer rice, chicken and vegetables, add avocado and lime
3 tomatoes, 1 onion, 1 garlic clove
2 cups chicken stock
50 g shredded cooked chicken
1 corn tortilla, cut into strips
Avocado, coriander, lime, chilli
Char the tomatoes, onion and garlic, then blend them
Cook the purée 5 minutes and add the stock
Bake the tortilla strips until crisp
Add the chicken and serve topped with tortilla and avocado
Small corn tortillas, 4 pieces (120 g)
Cooked, shredded chicken breast 140 g
Green tomatillo salsa 200 g
Low-fat grated cheese 40 g
Low-fat Greek yogurt 2 tbsp to serve
Chopped onion and chopped fresh coriander
Warm the tortillas slightly to make them pliable.
Fill each tortilla with shredded chicken and roll tightly, arrange in a lined baking dish.
Pour the tomatillo salsa over the rolls, sprinkle with cheese.
Bake at 200°C for 18-20 minutes until the cheese melts, garnish with yogurt, onion and coriander and serve hot.

name.en: Pozole Verde de Pollo (Green Hominy Chicken Soup)

en: Canned hominy corn, drained, 150 g
Chicken breast, cut into large pieces, 140 g
Green tomatillo salsa 200 g
Chopped onion and 1 crushed garlic clove
Light chicken stock 400 ml and chopped fresh coriander
Shredded lettuce, sliced radish and lime to serve
Brown the onion and garlic in a dry pot for 3 minutes.
Add the chicken, stock and green salsa, cover and simmer 15-18 minutes until the chicken is fully cooked.
Remove the chicken and shred with two forks, return to the pot with the hominy, cook 5 more minutes.
Serve the pozole hot with lettuce, radish, lime juice and fresh coriander.
Small corn tortillas, baked crisp (tostadas), 2 pieces (60 g)
Peeled medium shrimp 140 g
Mashed black beans 60 g
Sliced avocado and diced tomato, 80 g total
Shredded lettuce and lemon juice
A pinch of ground cumin, salt and black pepper
Season the shrimp with cumin, salt, black pepper and lemon juice.
Bake at 220°C for 8-10 minutes until fully cooked.
Spread the mashed beans on each tostada, arrange the lettuce over it.
Arrange the shrimp, avocado and tomato over the tostada and serve immediately before it softens.
Cooked, shredded chicken breast 140 g
Diced tomato and chopped onion, 150 g total
1 crushed garlic clove and mild ground chipotle chili half a tsp (or smoked paprika)
Cooked brown rice 100 g
Shredded lettuce and sliced avocado to serve
Salt and black pepper
Brown the onion and garlic in a dry pot for 3 minutes.
Add the tomato and chipotle chili, cook 5-6 minutes until the sauce thickens.
Add the shredded chicken, salt and black pepper, cook 3-4 minutes until it absorbs the flavour.
Place the rice in a serving bowl, add the chicken tinga on top, garnish with lettuce and avocado and serve.

name.en: Baked Tostada Salad with Black Beans and Chicken

en: Small corn tortilla, baked crisp (tostada), 1 large piece (40 g)
Mashed black beans 60 g
Cooked, shredded chicken breast 140 g
Shredded lettuce and diced tomato, 150 g total
Low-fat grated cheese 20 g and low-fat Greek yogurt 2 tbsp
Sliced avocado for garnish
Spread the mashed beans on the tostada.
Arrange the lettuce, tomato and shredded chicken over it.
Sprinkle with the cheese, drizzle the yogurt over it.
Garnish with avocado slices and serve immediately before the tostada softens.
Chicken breast, cut into large pieces, 140 g
Light chicken stock 400 ml
Diced tomato, chopped onion and 1 crushed garlic clove
Fresh lime juice 2 tbsp and grated lime zest a pinch
Small corn tortilla, cut into strips and baked, 30 g to serve
Sliced avocado and chopped fresh coriander for garnish
Brown the onion and garlic in a dry pot for 3 minutes.
Add the tomato, chicken and stock, cover and simmer 15-18 minutes until the chicken is fully cooked.
Remove the chicken and shred with two forks, return to the pot, add the lime juice and zest.
Serve the soup hot with the baked tortilla strips, avocado and coriander.
Tilapia fillet or similar white fish 140 g
Diced tomato and chopped onion, 150 g total
Pitted green olives, halved, 1 tbsp
2 crushed garlic cloves and a little chopped mild chili (optional)
Dried oregano half a tsp and lemon juice 1 tbsp
1 tsp olive oil, salt and black pepper
Arrange the fish fillet on a lined baking tray.
Brown the onion and garlic in a dry pot for 3 minutes, add the tomato, olives, chili and oregano, cook 5 minutes.
Pour the sauce over the fish, sprinkle with lemon juice, oil, salt and black pepper.
Bake at 200°C for 18-20 minutes until the fish is cooked and flaky, serve hot.
Whole-wheat tortillas, 2 pieces (120 g)
Low-fat turkey ham, sliced, 80 g
Low-fat grated cheese 40 g
Sliced tomato and sliced avocado to serve
Light salsa to serve (optional)
Shredded lettuce to serve
Place the turkey ham and cheese on one tortilla, cover with the other tortilla.
Arrange on a lined tray.
Bake at 200°C for 8-10 minutes on each side until golden and the cheese melts.
Cut into quarters, serve with the tomato, avocado, lettuce and salsa if desired.
150 g white fish
2 corn tortillas
1 cup shredded red cabbage
3 tbsp Greek yogurt, lime juice
Paprika, cumin, coriander, salt
Season the fish with the spices and rest 10 minutes
Grill 3-4 minutes per side, then flake it
Mix the yogurt with lime and salt for a white sauce
Warm the tortillas, layer cabbage, fish and sauce
2 large bell peppers
Half cup black beans
Half cup sweetcorn
50 g cooked brown rice
30 g low-fat cheese, cumin, coriander
Cut the tops off the peppers and remove the seeds
Mix the beans, corn, rice and spices
Stuff the peppers and top with the cheese
Bake at 190°C for 25 minutes
Chicken breast 140 g
Diced tomato and chopped onion, 150 g total
1 crushed garlic clove and mild soaked and mashed ancho chili (or paprika) 1 tsp
Unsweetened raw cocoa powder 1 tsp and a pinch of ground cinnamon
Ground almonds 1 tbsp and light chicken stock 150 ml
Cooked brown rice 100 g to serve
Season the chicken with salt and black pepper, cook in a dry pot for 4-5 minutes on each side until golden, set aside.
In the same pot, brown the onion and garlic for 3 minutes, add the tomato and ancho chili, cook 4 minutes.
Add the cocoa, cinnamon, ground almonds and stock, mix well until the sauce is smooth, simmer 8-10 minutes.
Return the chicken to the sauce, cover and cook another 10-12 minutes until fully cooked, serve with the brown rice.
Lean flank steak 140 g
Lemon juice 2 tbsp and 2 crushed garlic cloves
Ground cumin and dried oregano half a tsp each
Bell pepper and onion, cut into thick slices, 200 g total for grilling
1 tsp olive oil, salt and black pepper
Chopped fresh coriander for garnish
Mix the lemon juice, garlic, cumin and oregano, marinate the meat in it for at least 30 minutes (or overnight in the fridge).
Grill the meat under the broiler or on a grill pan 4-5 minutes on each side depending on desired doneness, let it rest 5 minutes then slice thinly against the grain.
Mix the bell pepper and onion with the oil, salt and black pepper, grill 8-10 minutes until tender and charred at the edges.
Arrange the meat slices with the grilled vegetables, garnish with coriander and serve.
Large poblano peppers, 2 pieces (or large green bell peppers)
Cooked, shredded chicken breast 100 g
Diced tomato and chopped onion
Low-fat grated cheese 40 g
2 egg whites for a light coating
A pinch of ground cumin, salt and black pepper
Roast the peppers under the broiler 5-6 minutes until the skin blisters, place in a sealed plastic bag for 10 minutes then peel gently.
Cut a lengthwise slit in each pepper and carefully remove the seeds while keeping it whole.
Mix the shredded chicken with the tomato, onion, cheese, cumin, salt and black pepper, stuff the peppers with the mixture.
Dip each stuffed pepper in the egg white, arrange on a lined tray, bake at 200°C for 15-18 minutes until golden and the cheese melts, serve hot.
Lean pork, cut into cubes, 140 g
Green tomatillo salsa 250 g
Chopped onion and 2 crushed garlic cloves
Mild green chili, diced, 50 g
Ground cumin and dried oregano half a tsp each
Light meat stock 150 ml and chopped fresh coriander
Brown the pork in a dry pot for 4-5 minutes until golden, set aside.
In the same pot, brown the onion, garlic and green chili for 4 minutes.
Add the green salsa, cumin, oregano and stock, mix well.
Return the pork to the pot, cover and simmer 30-35 minutes until fully cooked, garnish with coriander and serve hot.
Lean pork, cut into large pieces, 140 g
Fresh orange juice and lemon juice 2 tbsp each
Achiote (annatto) paste 1 tsp (or paprika with cumin as a substitute)
2 crushed garlic cloves and dried oregano half a tsp
Banana leaf or baking paper for wrapping (optional)
Pickled red onion, thinly sliced, to serve
Mix the orange juice, lemon juice, achiote paste, garlic and oregano to make the marinade.
Marinate the pork in it and let it sit at least 30 minutes (or overnight in the fridge).
Wrap the pork in the banana leaf or baking paper, place in a baking tray.
Bake at 180°C for 50-60 minutes until fully cooked and very tender, shred with two forks and serve with the pickled red onion.
Large shrimp, peeled, 140 g
Zucchini, cut into half-moon slices, 150 g
Light tomato sauce 100 g and mild chili, chopped, half a tsp
2 crushed garlic cloves and lemon juice 1 tbsp
1 tsp olive oil, salt and black pepper
Chopped fresh coriander for garnish
Brown the garlic in a dry pan for one minute.
Add the zucchini and cook 4-5 minutes until it starts to soften.
Add the tomato sauce, chili, lemon juice, salt and black pepper, cook 3 minutes.
Add the shrimp and cook 3-4 minutes until fully cooked, garnish with coriander and serve hot.

name.en: Baked Albóndigas en Chipotle (Meatballs in Chipotle Sauce)

en: Lean minced turkey 140 g
Cooked rice 2 tbsp and grated onion for the filling
1 egg, salt and black pepper for the filling
Light tomato sauce 200 g and mild ground chipotle chili half a tsp (or smoked paprika)
2 crushed garlic cloves and light meat stock 100 ml for the sauce
Cooked brown rice 100 g to serve
Mix the minced turkey with the rice, grated onion, egg, salt and black pepper until it binds together.
Shape into small balls, arrange on a lined tray.
Bake at 200°C for 15-18 minutes until golden.
Brown the garlic in a dry pot for a minute, add the tomato sauce, chipotle and stock, cook 5 minutes, add the meatballs and cook 5 more minutes, serve with the brown rice.
Lean minced beef 140 g
Potato, cut into small cubes, and carrot, diced, 150 g total
Diced tomato, chopped onion and 1 crushed garlic clove
Raisins 1 tbsp and green olives, halved, 1 tbsp (optional)
Ground cumin and ground cinnamon a pinch each
Light meat stock 100 ml, salt and black pepper
Brown the minced beef in a dry pot for 4-5 minutes until golden.
Add the onion and garlic, cook 3 minutes.
Add the potato, carrot, tomato, stock, cumin, cinnamon, salt and black pepper, cover and simmer 18-20 minutes until the vegetables are cooked.
Add the raisins and olives if desired, cook 3 more minutes and serve hot.
Half a ripe avocado
Quarter red onion, finely chopped
1 small tomato, chopped
Juice of half a lime, coriander
Carrot, cucumber, pepper sticks
Mash the avocado with a fork, leaving some chunks
Add the onion, tomato and coriander
Add the lime juice and salt, fold gently
Serve at once with the vegetable sticks
150 g corn kernels
2 tbsp Greek yogurt
1 tbsp crumbled white cheese
Juice of half a lime
Paprika, chilli powder, coriander
Char the corn in a dry pan until spotted brown
Toss it with the yogurt and lime juice
Add the cheese, paprika and chilli
Top with coriander and serve warm
Jicama, peeled and cut into sticks, 200 g
Fresh lime juice 2 tbsp
Chili powder half a tsp
A little salt
An extra pinch of cayenne pepper for heat (optional)
Arrange the jicama sticks on a serving plate.
Pour the lime juice over them and toss gently.
Sprinkle with the chili powder, salt and cayenne pepper if desired.
Let sit 5 minutes for the flavours to infuse and serve cold.

name.en: Black Bean and Corn Salsa Cups

en: Canned black beans, drained, 100 g
Canned sweet corn, drained, 60 g
Diced tomato and chopped red onion
Lemon juice 1 tbsp and chopped fresh coriander
A pinch of ground cumin, salt and black pepper
Small baked corn chips to serve (optional)
Mix the black beans, corn, tomato and red onion in a bowl.
Add the lemon juice, coriander, cumin, salt and black pepper.
Stir well until the ingredients are combined.
Distribute into serving cups, let sit 10 minutes for the flavours to infuse and serve with the corn chips if desired.

name.en: Baked Zucchini and Cheese Quesadilla Wedges

en: Whole-wheat tortilla, 1 large piece (60 g)
Grated zucchini, drained of excess water, 80 g
Low-fat grated cheese 40 g
Chopped spring onion
A pinch of ground cumin, salt and black pepper
Low-fat Greek yogurt 1 tbsp to serve (optional)
Mix the grated zucchini with the cheese, spring onion, cumin, salt and black pepper.
Spread the mixture over half the tortilla, fold the other half over it.
Arrange on a lined tray, bake at 200°C for 10-12 minutes on each side until golden and crisp.
Cut into 4 triangular wedges and serve with the yogurt if desired.

name.en: Pico de Gallo with Baked Tortilla Chips

en: Tomato, cut into small cubes, 150 g
Chopped white onion and a little chopped mild green chili
Chopped fresh coriander and lemon juice 1 tbsp
A little salt
Small corn tortillas, cut into triangles and baked, 40 g to serve
Mix the tomato, white onion and green chili in a bowl.
Add the coriander, lemon juice and salt, stir gently.
Let the mixture rest 10 minutes in the fridge for the flavours to infuse.
Bake the tortilla triangles in the oven at 180°C for 10-12 minutes until crisp and serve with the pico de gallo.
Nopales (cactus paddles), peeled and diced, 150 g
Diced tomato and chopped red onion
Chopped fresh coriander and lemon juice 1 tbsp
Queso fresco or low-fat crumbled cheese 20 g
1 tsp olive oil, salt and black pepper
A little chopped mild chili (optional)
Boil the diced nopales in boiling water 5-7 minutes until tender, drain and rinse with cold water to remove the sliminess.
Mix with the tomato, red onion and chili if desired.
Add the coriander, lemon juice, oil, salt and black pepper, stir gently.
Distribute into serving cups, sprinkle with cheese and serve cold.
Cooked, mashed sweet potato 100 g
Canned black beans, drained and mashed, 40 g
Ground cumin and paprika a pinch each
Small corn tortillas, 3 pieces (75 g)
Low-fat grated cheese 20 g
A light spray of olive oil
Mix the mashed sweet potato with the mashed beans, cumin and paprika until combined.
Warm the tortillas slightly to make them pliable, place two spoonfuls of filling in the centre of each.
Roll tightly into a thin cylinder, arrange on a lined tray seam-side down.
Spray lightly with oil, bake at 200°C for 15-18 minutes until golden and crisp, sprinkle with cheese in the last 2 minutes and serve.
Green plantain, peeled and cut into very thin slices, 200 g
A light spray of olive oil
A little salt
Fresh lime juice 1 tbsp
A pinch of mild chili powder (optional)
Arrange the thin plantain slices on a lined tray in a single layer without overlapping.
Spray lightly with oil.
Bake at 180°C for 15-18 minutes, turning halfway, until crisp and golden.
Let cool slightly, sprinkle with salt, lime juice and chili powder if desired and serve.
Raw pumpkin seeds (pepitas) 30 g
Fresh lime juice 1 tsp
Chili powder half a tsp
A little salt
A pinch of paprika (optional)
Mix the pumpkin seeds with the lime juice, chili powder, salt and paprika if desired.
Spread on a lined tray in a single layer.
Roast in the oven at 170°C for 8-10 minutes, turning halfway, until they puff slightly and turn a little golden (watch closely so they don't burn).
Let cool completely before serving to become crisp.
2 tbsp chia seeds
Half cup milk (or almond milk)
Half a mango, puréed
1 tsp honey
A pinch of cinnamon or lime zest
Mix the chia with the milk and honey thoroughly
Wait 10 minutes, then stir again
Chill 4 hours or overnight
Top with the mango purée and dust with cinnamon
1 ripe banana
A pinch of cinnamon
Juice of a quarter lime
1 tsp honey
1 tbsp Greek yogurt
Split the banana lengthwise in its skin
Drizzle the cinnamon, honey and lime juice inside
Bake at 180°C for 15 minutes
Serve hot with a spoon of yogurt
Sweet potato, cut into cubes, 200 g
Ground cinnamon 1 tsp
Lemon juice 1 tsp
Honey 1 tsp
A pinch of salt
A pinch of ground cloves (optional)
Mix the sweet potato cubes with the cinnamon, lemon juice, honey, salt and cloves if desired.
Spread on a lined tray in a single layer.
Bake at 200°C for 20-25 minutes, turning halfway, until cooked and golden at the edges.
Let cool slightly before serving.
Watermelon, seeded and cubed, 300 g
Lemon juice 2 tbsp
Fresh mint 1 tsp (optional)
Honey 1 tsp (optional depending on the sweetness of the watermelon)
Blend the watermelon with the lemon juice, mint and honey if desired until smooth and liquid.
Strain the mixture if desired for a smoother, seed-free texture.
Pour into popsicle molds, place the wooden sticks in the centre.
Freeze for at least 4-6 hours until fully frozen before serving.
Whole-wheat flour 50 g
Water 80 ml and low-fat butter 1 tsp
1 egg
A pinch of vanilla extract
Ground cinnamon 1 tsp and brown sugar 1 tbsp for coating
A pinch of salt
Heat the water with the butter and salt in a small pot until boiling.
Add the flour all at once and stir vigorously until a ball of dough forms, let the dough cool 3 minutes.
Add the egg and vanilla and mix well until combined.
Pipe the dough into small pieces on a lined tray, bake at 200°C for 18-20 minutes until puffed and golden, roll in the cinnamon and brown sugar mixture and serve warm.
Low-fat milk 200 ml
Chia seeds 2 tbsp
Ground cinnamon half a tsp
A pinch of vanilla extract
Honey 1 tbsp
An extra cinnamon stick for garnish (optional)
Mix the milk with the chia seeds, cinnamon, vanilla and honey in a bowl.
Stir well until the chia seeds are evenly distributed.
Cover the bowl and refrigerate for at least 4 hours (overnight is best) until the texture thickens.
Stir again before serving, garnish with a cinnamon stick if desired and serve cold.
Whole-wheat flour 40 g and baking powder half a tsp
1 egg and 2 egg whites
Brown sugar 2 tbsp and a pinch of vanilla extract
Low-fat evaporated or regular milk 60 ml for the batter
Low-fat milk 80 ml with 1 tbsp honey for soaking
Low-fat Greek yogurt 2 tbsp to serve
Whisk the egg and egg whites with the brown sugar and vanilla until foamy.
Add the flour, baking powder and evaporated milk, gently mix until the texture is combined.
Pour into a small oven-safe dish lined with baking paper, bake at 180°C for 20-22 minutes until golden.
Mix the milk and honey, gradually pour over the warm cake to soak in, chill in the fridge for an hour, serve with the yogurt.
Fresh pineapple, cut into pieces, 200 g
Chili powder half a tsp
Fresh lime juice 1 tbsp
A light pinch of salt
Chopped fresh mint for garnish (optional)
Arrange the pineapple pieces on a serving plate.
Pour the lime juice over them.
Sprinkle the chili powder and a light pinch of salt evenly.
Garnish with mint if desired and serve immediately.
Low-fat milk 200 ml
Unsweetened raw cocoa powder 2 tbsp
Ground cinnamon half a tsp and a very small pinch of cayenne pepper (optional for a light touch of heat)
1 egg
Honey 2 tbsp
A pinch of vanilla extract
Whisk the egg with the honey and vanilla until combined.
Heat the milk in a small pot until nearly boiling, add the cocoa, cinnamon and cayenne if desired, whisk until the cocoa fully dissolves.
Gradually pour the warm milk over the egg mixture while stirring constantly.
Pour into small oven-safe cups, place them in a tray with hot water reaching halfway up, bake at 160°C for 35-40 minutes until set, chill in the fridge before serving.
Guava paste (ate de guayaba), cut into small cubes, 60 g
Queso fresco or low-fat cheese, cut into small cubes, 60 g
Coarsely chopped and toasted walnuts 1 tsp (optional)
Fresh mint for garnish (optional)
Arrange the guava paste and cheese cubes alternating on small skewers or on a serving plate.
Sprinkle with the toasted walnuts if desired.
Garnish with fresh mint if desired.
Serve at room temperature or slightly chilled.
